name: First Embrace
summary: Sets up kangaroo care wards in Nigerian hospitals, training nurses to care for small and low birth weight newborns.

spending.source: https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/wGXCuedzsubqNDAca/introducing-first-embrace-an-ambitious-impact-incubated (pilot report 4.3: seed grant $163,150 for set-up and February to August 2026) and https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WUFh0SpvjWNjqop0h49RDnwee4CbB_Wtc1YR3P4VTpg/edit (its reach and cost model: average monthly spend July to September 2026 $27,695, times September to December); no accounts are published yet
